content: Please consult your doctor immediately if you experience symptoms of low blood sugar, such as sudden sweating, shaking, hunger, blurred vision, dizziness, or tingling in your hands or feet. Chloroquine can cause a condition known as QT prolongation, which affects the heart's rhythm. The risk of QT prolongation may be higher if you have certain medical conditions or are taking other medications that can also cause QT prolongation. Low levels of potassium or magnesium in the blood can further increase this risk, especially if you are using diuretics (water pills) or experiencing severe sweating, diarrhea, or vomiting. During pregnancy, chloroquine should only be used if absolutely necessary, as it passes into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. It is essential to keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal supplements, and share this information with your doctor and pharmacist. Certain vaccines, such as the rabies or cholera vaccine, may not work as effectively if administered while you are taking chloroquine. If someone overdoses on this medication and exhibits severe symptoms like passing out or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911 in the U.S.) or contact a poison control center immediately. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. If you are taking chloroquine for an extended period, regular medical and laboratory tests, such as eye exams, reflex tests, liver and kidney function tests, EKGs, and complete blood counts, are recommended. Stay indoors or in well-screened areas whenever possible. If you are using this medication to prevent or treat malaria, use it only for your current travel or condition. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this medication and your specific health needs.
